info.title: FluentSetup - build Windows installers.
info.description: fluentsetup: the command-line tool of FluentSetup. Builds native Windows 11-style installers (a single Setup.exe) from a fluentsetup.json, validates projects, inspects packages and writes winget manifests. Includes the installer runtime.

commands.name: build
commands.description: Build Setup.exe

options.name: --output
options.description:
Output folder (default: project output.directory)
Root folder (default: current folder): <dir>/manifests/<x>/<Publisher>/<App>/<version>

options.name: --arch
options.description: Target architecture (default: project output.architecture)

options.name: --variant
options.description: Variants to include (default: project output.variants, else all)

options.name: --no-sign
options.description: Override the project's signing setting

options.name: --report
options.description: Write a machine-readable build report

options.name: --runtime
options.description: Use another installer runtime folder

options.name: --define
options.description:
Value for $(name) in the project (repeatable; overrides "variables"),
e.g. -D Version=1.2.1 with "version": "$(Version)"

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Detailed log

options.name: --json
options.description: Print the build report as JSON instead of text

options.name: --non-interactive
options.description: Never prompt (the default; accepted for CI scripts)

options.name: --refresh-installers
options.description: Download official prerequisite installers ("auto": "bundle") again

options.name: --msbuild
options.description:
Diagnostics as "<project> : error FS1234: ..." (for the MSBuild targets)
fluentsetup validate <project.json> [--json] [-D <name>=<value> ...]
fluentsetup inspect <Setup.exe> [--verify] [--json]
fluentsetup init [folder] --name <name> --id <app.id> --source <files folder> [--publisher <name>]
fluentsetup winget <Setup.exe> --url <https URL> | --github <owner/repo> [options]
Write winget manifests (winget-pkgs layout) for a built Setup.exe

options.name: --identifier
options.description: PackageIdentifier (default: app.id if it is Publisher.App)

options.name: --license
options.description: e.g. MIT (default: recognized from the license text, else Proprietary)

options.name: --short-description
options.description:
fluentsetup import <setup.iss|script.nsi> [-o <folder>] [--force] [--json]
Convert an Inno Setup or NSIS script into <folder>\fluentsetup.json
(default folder: the script's) plus import-report.md, a checklist of
what was mapped and what needs manual work
fluentsetup locale add <language> <project.json> [--force]
Create <ui.localization>/<language>.json with every text to translate
(option/action/variant ids, and the installer strings for a language it
does not ship); any BCP-47 tag, e.g. nl-NL or pt-PT
fluentsetup update [--check] [--prerelease] [--json]
Update FluentSetup (Builder and CLI) to the latest release on GitHub:
downloads Setup.exe, verifies its SHA-256 and installs it (Windows only).
--check only reports; --json (with --check) prints the result as JSON
fluentsetup versions <webview2|windowsappruntime|dotnet|vcredist> [--json]
Versions to use as a prerequisite's minimum (from Microsoft's
update feeds, cached for a day; vcredist: common minimums)
fluentsetup guide                     Print the complete project-authoring guide (for people and AI tools)
fluentsetup schema                    Print the JSON Schema of fluentsetup.json
fluentsetup --version | --help

Diagnostics as "<project> : error FS1234: ..." (for the MSBuild targets)
fluentsetup validate <project.json> [--json] [-D <name>=<value> ...]

fluentsetup init [folder] --name <name> --id <app.id> --source <files folder> [--publisher <name>]
fluentsetup winget <Setup.exe> --url <https URL> | --github <owner/repo> [options]
Write winget manifests (winget-pkgs layout) for a built Setup.exe

options.name: --identifier
options.description: PackageIdentifier (default: app.id if it is Publisher.App)

options.name: --license
options.description: e.g. MIT (default: recognized from the license text, else Proprietary)

options.name: --short-description
options.description:
fluentsetup import <setup.iss|script.nsi> [-o <folder>] [--force] [--json]
Convert an Inno Setup or NSIS script into <folder>\fluentsetup.json
(default folder: the script's) plus import-report.md, a checklist of
what was mapped and what needs manual work
fluentsetup locale add <language> <project.json> [--force]
Create <ui.localization>/<language>.json with every text to translate
(option/action/variant ids, and the installer strings for a language it
does not ship); any BCP-47 tag, e.g. nl-NL or pt-PT
fluentsetup update [--check] [--prerelease] [--json]
Update FluentSetup (Builder and CLI) to the latest release on GitHub:
downloads Setup.exe, verifies its SHA-256 and installs it (Windows only).
--check only reports; --json (with --check) prints the result as JSON
fluentsetup versions <webview2|windowsappruntime|dotnet|vcredist> [--json]
Versions to use as a prerequisite's minimum (from Microsoft's
update feeds, cached for a day; vcredist: common minimums)
fluentsetup guide                     Print the complete project-authoring guide (for people and AI tools)
fluentsetup schema                    Print the JSON Schema of fluentsetup.json
fluentsetup --version | --help
